name: Cross-Ticket Isolation
description: Enforces that cross-ticket discussions stay in session memory and are never written to any active ticket's notes file.

enforceIsolation.label: Enforce Isolation
enforceIsolation.description: Master switch for cross-ticket isolation. When on (default), TPM refuses to write non-active-ticket content into the active ticket's notes. When off, no isolation is enforced.

allowCrossTicketNoteWrite.label: Allow Cross-Ticket Note Write
allowCrossTicketNoteWrite.description: When on (default), TPM may write a standalone note to another ticket's notes file when a discovery genuinely belongs there. When off, all writes outside the active ticket are refused.

promptBeforeCrossWrite.label: Prompt Before Cross-Write
promptBeforeCrossWrite.description: When on (default), TPM asks for confirmation before writing a cross-ticket note. When off, TPM writes it directly without asking.

onIsolationViolation.label: On Isolation Violation
onIsolationViolation.description: How TPM responds to a would-be cross-ticket write into the active ticket's file. refuse (default): block it and surface the violation. log-only: write it with a warning marker. ask: prompt per occurrence.
